observation.command: cd /workspace && echo "=== env keys ==="; grep -E '^(DATABASE_URL|TEST_DATABASE_URL|SHADOW_DATABASE_URL|VALKEY_SERVER|VALKEY_PORT|VALKEY_PERSISTENT_SERVER|VALKEY_PERSISTENT_PORT|STORAGE_BUCKET|STORAGE_URL|CRYPTO_SECRET|WEBAPP_DEV_USER_PW)' .env | sed 's/=.*/=<set>/'; echo "=== SESSION_KEY set? ==="; grep -c '^SESSION_KEY=.\+' .env; echo "=== members/account count ==="; docker exec postgis psql -U postgres -d ffy_dev -tAc 'select count(*) from "Member"; select count(*) from "Account";' 2>&1
